newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures firm after quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures firm after quiet trade.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures finished firmer after quiet trade on Wednesday, helped by the dollar's strength and aluminium's firm tone on the LME, traders said.
"Nobody is interested in buying the contracts until they see some increases in the yen-based contracts," said one trader at a major trading house. "They feel too uncertain."

TOCOM benchmark April 1998 closed 1.0 yen higher at 196.7 yen per kg. It moved in a narrow range of between 196.4 and 197.8 after opening at 196.6. Other contracts, which saw only small turnover, finished up by between 0.9 yen and 1.5 yen.
Traders said the dollar's upward move towards 117 yen lent some support as well as a firm aluminium close in London on Tuesday, but profit-taking by individual investors trimmed gains.
